<style>
  .hod-service-link {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: inherit;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }

  .hod-service-link:hover {
    text-decoration: none;
    color: inherit;
  }

  .hod-service-card {
    padding: 24px;
    text-align: center;
    background: #ffffff;
    border: 1px solid #dce6f2;
    border-radius: 16px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(11, 42, 74, 0.08);
    min-height: 150px;
    transition: all 0.25s ease;
    cursor: pointer;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    margin-top: 15px;
  }

  .hod-service-card::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0b2a4a, #1a5276);
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
    border-radius: 16px;
  }

  .hod-service-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(11, 42, 74, 0.14);
    border-color: #1d7ab3;
  }

  .hod-service-card:hover::before {
    opacity: 0.03;
  }

  .hod-service-card .icon {
    font-size: 36px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    display: block;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
  }

  .hod-service-card:hover .icon {
    transform: scale(1.1) rotate(-5deg);
  }

  .hod-service-card h3 {
    margin: 0 0 8px;
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif;
    font-size: 20px;
    color: #0b2a4a;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
  }

  .hod-service-card:hover h3 {
    color: #1a5276;
  }

  .hod-service-card p {
    margin: 0;
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif;
    font-size: 14px;
    color: #5b7088;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
  }

  .hod-service-card:hover p {
    color: #2c4a6a;
  }
sp_page.title: HOD Dashboard
